title: Add AGENTS.md with Cursor Cloud development instructions
body: ## Summary Adds `AGENTS.md` with development environment instructions for Cursor Cloud agents. ### What's covered - Codebase overview (4 independent Cursor SDK example projects) - Runtime requirements (Node.js 22 via nvm, pnpm 10.x, Bun 1.3+) - Lint/typecheck/build commands per project - API key requirements (`CURSOR_API_KEY`) - Key caveats: `pnpm install --ignore-scripts` (sqlite3 native build issues), Google Fonts egress for `next build`, port conflicts between Next.js apps ### Environment verified | Check | Status | |---|---| | `pnpm lint` (app-builder) | Pass | | `pnpm lint` (agent-kanban) | Pass | | `pnpm typecheck` (quickstart) | Pass | | `pnpm typecheck` (coding-agent-cli) | Pass | | `pnpm build` (quickstart) | Pass | | `pnpm build` (coding-agent-cli) | Pass | | `pnpm dev` (app-builder :3000) | Running | | `pnpm dev` (agent-kanban :3001) | Running | ### Demo Both Next.js apps load their onboarding screens successfully: ![App Builder onboarding screen](https://cursor.com/artifacts/c/art-6d19c12d-76ab-451d-80cf-a8f3cefbceb2) ![Agent Kanban onboarding screen](https://cursor.com/artifacts/c/art-d37eee6c-81ae-4525-9d44-a3fca89416b5)
